name: SpringBoardGame
tagline: 长按主屏幕后选择使用 App 图标游玩贪吃蛇或俄罗斯方块。
description: 主屏幕游戏将图标贪吃蛇和图标俄罗斯方块合并到同一个插件中，并共用一次长按启动与游戏选择界面。
两款游戏都使用设备中已安装 App 的图标，结束后可以再次游玩或恢复原主屏幕。
notice: 🎮 长按主屏幕底部的 Search 按钮或页面指示器，然后选择贪吃蛇或俄罗斯方块。安装本插件时会自动替换已安装的 IconSnake 与 IconTetris。
features: 长按后选择贪吃蛇或俄罗斯方块
使用已安装 App 的图标作为游戏元素
贪吃蛇支持滑动转向、成长、计分与逐渐加速
俄罗斯方块支持旋转、移动、软降、硬降、消行与等级加速
游戏结束后可重开或恢复主屏幕
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的主屏幕游戏，确认总开关已启用。
阅读两款游戏的玩法说明，并按需选择贪吃蛇图标耗尽后的行为。
返回主屏幕，长按底部 Search 按钮或页面指示器。
选择贪吃蛇或俄罗斯方块并开始游戏。

changes: 新增长按后选择贪吃蛇或俄罗斯方块的统一游戏入口。
新增两款游戏的完整玩法、计分、加速与主屏幕恢复功能。
增强三语设置说明，并自动替换独立的 IconSnake 与 IconTetris 包。

en.name: SpringBoardGame
en.tagline: Long-press the Home Screen, then choose Snake or Tetris using installed app icons.
description: SpringBoardGame combines IconSnake and IconTetris into one tweak with a shared long-press launcher and game selection screen.
Both games use icons from installed apps, and you can play again or restore the original Home Screen when a game ends.
en.notice: 🎮 Long-press the Search button or page indicator at the bottom of the Home Screen, then choose Snake or Tetris. Installing this package automatically replaces installed IconSnake and IconTetris packages.
features: Choose Snake or Tetris after a single long press
Use icons from installed apps as game elements
Snake with swipe steering, growth, scoring, and increasing speed
Tetris with rotation, movement, soft drop, hard drop, line clearing, and level speed
Play again or restore the Home Screen after a game
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open SpringBoardGame in Settings after installation and make sure it is enabled.
Read the instructions for both games and choose the Snake icon-pool behavior if needed.
Return to the Home Screen and long-press the Search button or page indicator.
Choose Snake or Tetris and start playing.

changes: Added a unified launcher for choosing Snake or Tetris after a long press.
Added complete gameplay, scoring, speed progression, and Home Screen restoration for both games.
Improved trilingual instructions and automatically replaced the standalone IconSnake and IconTetris packages.
